Methodology & sources

Balance identity (EIA Petroleum Supply Monthly): field production + transfers to crude supply + imports + adjustment = refinery & blender net inputs + exports + stock change (incl. SPR). Basis: months confirmed by the PSM are monthly actuals; months after PSM coverage are WPSR weekly-implied, measured calendar month-end to month-end (the level on the last day of a month is read between the weekly prints either side of it), except that the current month starts from the previous month's last WPSR print, so it is exactly the sum of this month's WPSR weekly changes, month-to-date (shown hatched) until complete. Cushing follows the same basis, from EIA's monthly Cushing series (MCRST_YCUOK_1). The seasonal average line covers the eight complete years before the chart's year (2020 optionally excluded) and is computed from EIA series MCRSCUS1 (monthly total-crude stock change).
How this updates as new data lands
Automatically: update_oil_dashboard.py asks EIA whether each source changed (conditional requests) and rebuilds the DATA block only when one did, or when the WPSR release workbook shows a new week. Each PSM print replaces that month's weekly-implied figure with the monthly survey actual.
